blocks.text: SEOUL — North Korea fired several missiles off its east coast Wednesday, Seoul’s military said, extending a burst of weapons testing as Pyongyang hardens its stance toward South Korea and the United States. The nuclear-equipped North has carried out a flurry of weapons tests in recent days, which come during heightened tensions between Pyongyang and Seoul
